note: Board stack exploded along z, seen from above (iso-top-right, true isometric, transparent background). Bottom to top: 4 F5 nylon M2.5 x 10 screws (pulled 22 mm below the sole), sole (45 % opaque so the screws show through; the 4 posts are the rings), radar board (lifted 10 mm, 45 % opaque), 4 F6 nylon M2.5 M-F 8 mm standoffs (lifted 20 mm, female end down, 6 mm stud up), feather (lifted 30 mm, dark blue, top), 4 F7 nylon nuts (lifted 42 mm). Insertion direction of the screws is +z (up, from the window face through sole post and radar board into the standoff female end); standoffs go up through the radar board holes into the feather holes; nuts go down onto the studs. Every piece of one position H1..H4 sits on ONE vertical (screen-vertical) axis line: H1 x=901, H2 x=1045, H3 x=1270, H4 x=1414. arrow_to for a screw is the hole in the sole window face (the underside; it is seen through the translucent sole), for a standoff the hole in the radar board, for a nut the hole in the feather. H positions: H1 (2.54,-2.54) USB end plain side, H2 (2.54,-20.32) USB end key side, H3 (48.26,-2.54) far end plain side, H4 (48.26,-20.32) far end key side (antenna corner, AE1 is just beyond H4; the nut flat faces AE1).
